name: Furuno Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Furuno Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells marine and industrial electronics equipment, wireless LAN system, and handheld terminal in Japan, the Americas, Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers radars, AIS and ECDIS systems, and satellite communication equipment for merchant vessels; fish finders, sonars, and radiotelephones for fishing vessels; and network-capable and multi-function navigation systems, as well as GPS and chart plotters, fish finders, and autopilot systems for sport fishing boats, sailboats, and yachts.
